## Research focus

This experience report addresses the development of generative AI literacy among university faculty through a nationwide online workshop. The work connects with my contributions to [AI and Me](../../Projects/AI_and_ME/AI_and_ME.qmd), including webinar implementation, accessible learning resources, and the self-paced course.
